360 Feedback: performance review process where an employee receives feedback from multiple sources, including self-evaluation, managers, and participants (such as peers or subordinates). It involves rating and commenting on competency items, calculating summary ratings, and submitting final evaluations through a structured system path.
Anchor Competency: tructured model outlining key competencies and proficiency levels (from Level 1 – Executing to Level 4 – Shaping)
